attrs.evidence: None. This is an open question, recorded so it cannot be lost.
attrs.gap: Conditional by construction, and the condition is the content. Where a currency exists — differential privacy is the worked case — the accountant is the right object. Where it does not, the honest answer is that exposure is irreversible and unquantified, which is EMB-EXPOSURE-IRREV. Nothing in this artifact has an exposure currency and nothing implements this.
attrs.prior_art: Rogers, Roth, Ullman & Vadhan 2016 for a case where the currency IS sound. GPT-5.6 §9 Correction B for the conditional.
attrs.statement: Exposure is accounted by an irreversible accountant wherever a sound exposure currency and meter exist.
